_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/costs/test_put_counters_cost.py. t_pcc_tome is Mazemind Tome's first line with a draw, so the counter and the effect can be told apart; t_pcc_ledger listens for page counters on itself, so a cost placement is shown to raise counter_placed; t_pcc_druid is Devoted Druid's -1/-1 for an untap, payable at any toughness; t_pcc_roots is Wall of Roots' shape on a charge counter, a mana ability whose only price is a counter,, which the payment solver must never pay on its own.
